content:
**Queen Mirelurk Meat** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Raw meat which has been harvested from the corpse of a Mirelurk Queen and stored in a can. It is considered to be a delacacy in Appalachia and fetches a high price when sold on the market due to the meat being surprisingly sweet. [1] It can be consumed raw to satisfy a very large amount of hunger with a very high dose of Radiation and chance for disease or can be cooked for additional benefits.

One piece can be given to Blackeye at Ohio River Adventures once per day as part of the Raider Fish Camp daily quest to earn raider reputation.

- Two pieces are guaranteed to be found on killed mirelurk queens. Use of the Butcher's Bounty perk gives a chance for an additional piece to drop.
- A chance to be sold by Marie in the Whitespring Resort.

1. ↑ Vault Dweller:*"Found some meat on a Mirelurk Queen. Figured you might be interested."*
 Blackeye:*"Ahh quite a delicacy! The meat is surprisingly sweet. This will fetch a high price."*
